trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 120 degrees and moderate indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Uniformly distributed high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (approximately 2-4 pixels in amplitude) along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across both lobes, tapering sharply to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of multiple small, high-intensity white punctate clusters (1-5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark dorsal surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of numerous small, circular white spots (likely barnacle scars) across the mid and distal regions of the fluke lobes.
